test_title: PYST 18: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 14th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: The letter B in the BODMAS rule stands for:
solution:
Bodmas stands for

B - Brackets

O - Orders (powers/indices or roots)

D - Division

M - Multiplication

A - Addition

S - Subtraction

**∴ The letter B in the BODMAS rule stands for Brackets.**
